name: Example contract cases
intended_population: Hypothetical contract excerpts with example text that agrees, conflicts, or stays incomplete. Synthetic development cases for this repository. No real specification and no real example.
sampling_method: Written by a coding agent to cover field names, runtime policy gaps, shadow behavior, wording, profile binding, embedded instructions, and ambiguous length semantics. No sampling of any real population.
label_guidelines: Consistent: every material field, value, and outcome of the example agrees with the supplied contract. Conflicting: at least one material field, value, or outcome conflicts with an explicit contract rule. Incomplete: no definite conflict, but missing or ambiguous contract details prevent one complete assessment.
